items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: I don't remember who was in Buddy P.T.T. band. That was a long time ago. But he was playing here at the entertainers.

ctx.x: Do you remember which Happy? Or is it Happy Gold? I think it's Happy Gold. The last one I was working on here at Paddock. Oh yeah. That's Happy Gold. He plays in Eureka. That's in Eureka. I played him and Henry Red Island.

That was my trumpet player. I used to love to hear him play trumpet. Him and Chris Kelly and Buddy P.T. Those who were trumpet players I used to get on the truck. When they would be playing on the truck I would hop on the truck and ride around. Listen to them. They didn't mind you getting on the truck? They didn't mind me getting on the truck because I used to be so little I could hand the handbills around. Oh yeah. They would get me all full of them. They'd tell me if you're going to ride you'd have to hand the…
Do you remember who was with Buddy P.T. when you'd hear him? Who was in his band? Yeah. The drummer in particular? Who was you?
